# Obsidian Vaults

An Obsidian vault is a directory of markdown files. The killer feature is `[[wikilinks]]` plus `#tags`, which together form a graph almost for free.

For my own system see [[Designing AI Memory]].

## Tips

- Treat the vault as the source of truth.
- Build downstream indices, not duplicates.
